main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of excess forward 30-bar return on forecast/10
main_measure.threshold: main slope t >= +2 confirms (with near-minus-far slope difference > 0); t <= -2 rejects; at least 300 independent grid cases

supporting_check.name: slope of excess forward return on past return, above-median W minus below-median W

decided_by: The main slope's t lies between -2 and +2.
reading: Grid positions 0/30/60/90 are used only where the bar 30 rows later exists in the same window; the coin mean is the mean of that coin's grid forward returns over all windows; the regression has an intercept; the median split is pooled over all coins, with cases exactly at the median left out.
